speaker: b_tanya
text: Power's out on our whole block and it's ninety-seven degrees. Mrs. Alvarez on five needs her oxygen machine, Mr. Chen's insulin is warming up, and everybody's group chat is full of rumors. Darnell's got a generator, Priya's got a car. Help me.

speaker: b_tanya
text: Mrs. Alvarez is on five in a walk-up, she's eighty-one and on home oxygen. Mr. Chen has his insulin pens in a fridge with no power. The Okafors on three have a newborn, three weeks old, and that apartment is an oven. Mr. James on two is in a power wheelchair, the elevator's out and his battery's at forty percent.
asked: Who on the block should Village know about, and which floor are they on?

speaker: b_tanya
text: Mrs. Alvarez only has her landline, she calls the block line from it. Mr. Chen has a flip phone, his grandson helps with English. Ramírez Deli on the corner has its own generator and about forty bags of ice, people call there.
asked: Who only has a regular phone or a landline? Is there a place people go to make calls?

speaker: b_tanya
text: Darnell's generator is a two-thousand-watt inverter, maybe six hours of fuel, outdoors only. He's home all day. Priya's car has A/C and fits three, she can fold a manual wheelchair but not a power chair.
asked: Who can help, with what, and when?

speaker: b_tanya
text: Anyone who can't breathe or passes out, 911 first, then me. Nobody waits for me.
asked: If someone can't breathe or passes out, what's the rule?

speaker: b_tanya
text: Me, Darnell, Priya and the Okafors use the app. Mr. James both. Mrs. Alvarez speaks Spanish, Mr. Chen Chinese, and the deli is Spanish too.
asked: Who will use an app, and who needs a call? Any languages besides English?

speaker: b_tanya
text: Darnell and Mr. James said call them anytime. Priya and the Okafors want the app only, no calls. Ask Mrs. Alvarez and Mr. Chen yourself.
asked: Can Village call people to check on them? Who said yes?
